notes: Replies now finish in the background — no babysitting the app. While anything is generating, the app runs a proper Android foreground service (you'll see a quiet 'Waiting on a reply — safe to switch away' notification), which stops Android from freezing the app when you lock the screen or switch away. The slow cold-start photo-read, the automatic retries, the streaming reply, the photo generation — all of it keeps running unattended, and the notification disappears the moment the reply lands. The screen also no longer needs to stay on: lock it, check your messages, come back to the finished reply. Auto-resume from 0.19.6 stays as the safety net if Android kills the app anyway.
